restoration_note: The teaching is a numbered litany of works the Lord performs within the self's architecture, each introduced by 'ⲡⲙⲁⲍ-N ⲭⲉ ⲁ...' (the Nth, because...). The ordinal scaffolding (second through tenth) and the recurring formula 'ⲭⲉ ⲁ' tightly constrain most gaps; partial traces (ⲁⲙⲧ → ⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ; ⲁⲍⲥⲁⲩ → ⲙⲁⲍⲥⲁⲩ; ⲟⲩⲛ → ⲙⲁⲍϣⲙⲟⲩⲛ; ⲙⲏⲧ → ⲙⲁⲍⲙⲏⲧ; ⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩ → ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ; ⲥⲙⲟⲥ → ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲗⲁⲥⲥⲙⲟⲥ; ⲍ̄ⲱⲛⲏ → ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ) lock in the technical vocabulary. A small number of content-heavy lacunae (the predicate of the fourth work {10}, the close of the fifth and the subject of the sixth {13}/{15}, the trailing prepositional phrase after night/day separation {27}) are too weakly constrained to restore honestly.
